subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in the brackets to fill in the blank.

Akash went to ______ his school uniform. [sell]
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **buy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sell"** means to give something in exchange for money. (बेचना)

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to sell her old car to buy a new one.
 
 
 
• **"Buy"** refers to acquiring something in exchange for money; it is the opposite action of selling. (खरीदना)
 
 
• **Example:** He went to the market to buy fresh vegetables.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'sell'** is **'buy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **buy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Loan** (ऋण): A thing that is borrowed, especially a sum of money that is expected to be paid back with interest.

 
 
• **Example:** He took a loan from the bank to buy a house.
 
 
 
• **Rent** (किराया): A tenant's regular payment to a landlord for the use of property or land.
 
 
• **Example:** They decided to rent an apartment in the city.
 
 
 
• **Make** (बनाना): Form (something) by putting parts together or combining substances; create.
 
 
• **Example:** She loves to make handmade gifts for her friends.
